en.headline: Hong Kong Ballet to move to Dancehouse at West Kowloon in 2027
en.dek: The company will leave the Cultural Centre after 16 years for the city's first dedicated dance venue, allowing more than 40 per cent more performance weeks.
body: Hong Kong Ballet will relocate to the Dancehouse at the WestK Performing Arts Centre from April 2027 for at least five years, the company and the West Kowloon Cultural District Authority said.

The move follows the ballet company's departure from its base of 16 years at the government-run Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui. Dancehouse is described as Hong Kong's first purpose-built centre dedicated to dance, with eight studios for training, research and creation.

Hong Kong Ballet artistic director Septime Webre said the shift would allow a more than 40 per cent increase in performance weeks annually. The WestK Performing Arts Centre, scheduled to open in 2027, also houses a 1,450-seat Grand Theatre and other venues.

An announcement last December that the company would leave the Cultural Centre had raised concerns about a suitable new home. The Dancehouse move addresses that gap and positions the company inside the expanding West Kowloon cultural district.

zh.headline: 香港芭蕾舞團2027年遷入西九舞藝中心
zh.dek: 舞團將結束在文化中心16年駐場，遷往全港首個專為舞蹈而設的場地，每年演出周數可增逾四成。
body: 香港芭蕾舞團及西九文化區管理局表示，舞團將由2027年4月起遷入西九演藝中心的舞藝中心，為期至少五年。
此舉結束舞團在尖沙咀文化中心16年的駐場安排。舞藝中心被稱為全港首個專為舞蹈而設的場地，設有八個工作室供訓練、研究及創作。
港芭藝術總監衛承天表示，遷址後每年演出周數可增加逾四成。西九演藝中心預計2027年開幕，另設有1,450座位的大劇院及其他場地。
去年12月有消息指舞團將離開文化中心，曾引起對合適新場地的關注。遷入舞藝中心解決了這個問題，並讓舞團置身正在擴展的西九文化區。
